patch_description: Restructure into three modular stages: (1) a randomized Las Vegas restart loop that runs the λ binary-search packing with shuffled model orderings, (2) a best-fit-λ feasibility packer shared by all restarts, and (3) a local-search refinement (move/swap off the hottest GPU) applied to each candidate. The best final max-KVPR placement across all restarts is returned, and all ratios are computed with a guard against zero free memory to avoid division-by-zero errors.
